plugins.name: maestro
plugins.description: Unified design, motion, 3D, and video super skill - thirteen upstream knowledge bases distilled into one voice over an eleven-corpus depth library. Higgsfield's and Comfy's first-party skills are the baseline for generative work: a live reachability probe, an OSS-vs-paid route gate, local-hardware checks, brand/product/thumbnail systems, and generated assets inside shipped pages. Grill-first process.
